","export class CardService {
 constructor() {
 this.assetTable = 'alm_asset';
 this.modelTable = 'cmdb_model';
 }

 async getUserCards() {
 try {
 // Get assets assigned to current user with model information
 const response = await fetch(
 `/api/now/table/${this.assetTable}?sysparm_query=assigned_to.user_name=javascript:gs.getUserName()&sysparm_display_value=all&sysparm_fields=sys_id,asset_tag,model,model.name,model.short_description,model.description,model.picture,install_date,cost,substatus`,
 {
 headers: {
 "Accept": "application/json",
 "X-UserToken": window.g_ck
 }
 }
 );

 if (!response.ok) {
 const error = await response.json();
 throw new Error(error.error?.message || 'Failed to fetch user cards');
 }

 const data = await response.json();
 return data.result || [];
 } catch (error) {
 console.error('Error fetching user cards:', error);
 throw error;
 }
 }

 async getCardDetails(modelSysId) {
 try {
 const response = await fetch(
 `/api/now/table/${this.modelTable}/${modelSysId}?sysparm_display_value=all`,
 {
 headers: {
 "Accept": "application/json",
 "X-UserToken": window.g_ck
 }
 }
 );

 if (!response.ok) {
 const error = await response.json();
 throw new Error(error.error?.message || 'Failed to fetch card details');
 }

 const data = await response.json();
